onboarding.subtitle: Three quick steps before your dashboard is ready.

workspaceProfile.title: Tailor your workspace
workspaceProfile.description: Choose the perspective that best matches your work. TeslaSync will prioritize navigation and discovery without hiding features or changing permissions.
workspaceProfile.label: Primary use

intro.title: Setup checklist
intro.desc: TeslaSync runs entirely on your hardware. No data leaves your install, and you can revisit this page from Settings any time.

tesla.title: Connect your Tesla account
tesla.desc: TeslaSync needs Fleet API access to read vehicle data. Sign in with your Tesla account to authorize the connection.

vehicle.title: Wait for vehicles to appear
vehicle.desc: Vehicles linked to your Tesla account will sync automatically. This usually takes less than a minute after connecting.

telemetry.title: Wait for telemetry data
telemetry.desc: Once your vehicle uploads its first signal batch (usually within 5 minutes of driving), live data will appear across the app. See the Fleet Telemetry setup guide if it does not arrive.

onboarding.ready: You are all set — your dashboard is ready.
onboarding.polling: This page refreshes automatically every 30 seconds.
onboarding.skipHint: Explore the app — you can finish setup later from this page.
onboarding.title: Welcome to TeslaSync
onboarding.syncDesc: Your Tesla account is connected. Sync your vehicles to start tracking.
onboarding.desc: The next-generation Tesla fleet intelligence platform. Connect your Tesla account to start real-time monitoring, analytics, and vehicle control.

resources.title: Resources & help
resources.privacy: TeslaSync runs entirely on your hardware. No data ever leaves your install.

account.title: Tesla account
account.desc: Connect or manage your Fleet API access.

guide.title: Fleet Telemetry setup guide
guide.desc: Configure streaming so live data starts arriving.

unlock.title: What you'll unlock
unlock.tracking: Follow location, speed, and state live on the map.
unlock.drives: Every trip logged with route, efficiency, and stats.
unlock.charging: Track sessions, costs, and battery health over time.
unlock.control: Climate, charging, and locks — all from one place.
